sources.title: Score-P application measurement
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: HPCToolkit 抽樣剖析：熱點比例與不確定性
related.titleEn: HPCToolkit sampling: hotspot proportions and uncertainty
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：量測成本與覆蓋範圍隨結論一起交付。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Perturbation and coverage accompany every conclusion.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「HPCToolkit 抽樣剖析：熱點比例與不確定性」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付呼叫樹、樣本計數、半寬與alias敏感度說明。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct HPCToolkit sampling: hotspot proportions and uncertainty with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver call trees, sample counts, half-widths and alias-sensitivity analysis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從100與130秒算額外成本，標示不能直接稱原程式性能。
以2500/10000得到p，計標準誤及95%近似半寬，標明獨立假設。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute added cost from 100 and 130 seconds and avoid calling the instrumented result native performance.
Use 2500/10000 for p and compute standard error and approximate 95% half-width, stating independence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Nextflow Resume：內容身分與工作目錄完整性
related.titleEn: Nextflow resume: content identity and work-directory integrity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：量測成本與覆蓋範圍隨結論一起交付。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Perturbation and coverage accompany every conclusion.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Nextflow Resume：內容身分與工作目錄完整性」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付cache身分、輸出manifest、重做集合與task-minutes帳本。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Nextflow resume: content identity and work-directory integrity with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver cache identities, output manifests, recompute sets and task-minute ledgers.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從100與130秒算額外成本，標示不能直接稱原程式性能。
由240扣180，將60張卡各標5 min，求總工作量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute added cost from 100 and 130 seconds and avoid calling the instrumented result native performance.
Subtract 180 from 240 and assign five minutes to each of sixty tasks.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
